headline: C&S Partners advises Dr. Lal PathLabs on acquiring 70% stake in SN Genelab
sum: Dr. Lal PathLabs Limited has acquired a 70% stake in SN Genelab Private Limited.
detail: Dr. Lal PathLabs Limited has acquired a 70% stake in SN Genelab Private Limited. C&S Partners advised Dr. Lal PathLabs on this acquisition.
